query: 产品安全政策 产品安全政策 衡量企业在产品设计、原材料采购、生产测试、上市后监测及召回等全生命周期中的安全管理机制。重点考察预防性设计、质量监测频率及产品安全责任的归属与闭环机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备“本质安全”设计准则；执行严于行业标准的内部测试；建立了主动的上市后安全监测（PMS）系统；具备明确的缺陷产品召回规程及高层负责的责任机制。 • 1分（合格）：建立了基础的质量管理体系（如 ISO 9001），具备标准化的出厂检测流程和被动的客户投诉处理机制，但缺乏全生命周期的预防性监控或明确的召回演练。 • 0分（不合格）：无正式产品安全政策披露，或仅有笼统的“质量至上”表述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：安全管理机制覆盖 >80% 的产品线、在售品项或业务收入，核心实体通过了行业特定的质量认证（如 IATF 16949, ISO 13485）。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅核心产品具备完整策略，或未说明具体覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 产品安全政策 产品质量管理 本质安全设计 产品测试 上市后监测 缺陷管理 质量认证 产品安全责任 ISO 9001 PMS ISO 13485 product safety policy product quality management design for safety product testing post-market surveillance PMS defect management ISO 9001 product liability ISO 13485 是否有覆盖产品设计、原材料采购、生产测试、上市后监测及召回的产品安全或质量管理政策？ 是否披露本质安全设计、FMEA等风险分析或内部测试？ 是否有标准化出厂检测和客户投诉处理？ 是否建立上市后安全监测、批次追溯及缺陷召回责任机制？ 机制覆盖多少产品线、在售品项或业务收入？ 核心实体取得哪些质量认证？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '产品安全政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有覆盖产品设计、原材料采购、生产测试、上市后监测及召回的产品安全或质量管理政策？ 是否披露本质安全设计、FMEA等风险分析或内部测试？ 是否有标准化出厂检测和客户投诉处理？ 是否建立上市后安全监测、批次追溯及缺陷召回责任机制？ 机制覆盖多少产品线、在售品项或业务收入？ 核心实体取得哪些质量认证？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有“质量至上”口号；仅有召回率数字而无制度；仅有负责任营销准则；仅有客户满意度调查；区分：产品安全政策关注全生命周期安全管理机制；召回程序关注召回制度与通知追踪；产品回收率是召回数量占比统计，不是政策本身。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

results.text: In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
OPERATIONAL EXCELLENCE / Supply Chain Management

[Content]
In order to reduce the ESG risks in the supply chain, we carry out due diligence in the supplier selection process. During procurement, we invite more than one quotation and conduct detailed background checks. We take social and environmental performance in aspects such as environmental protection, occupational health and safety and quality assurance etc., into consideration in the process of supplier selection. We also assign department managers to monitor vendors' performance regularly. An annual assessment review is conducted to ensure services or product quality of existing suppliers are in line with the Group's standards and expectations.

results.text: A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

A total of 26 potential topics were marked in the assessment covering environmental, social and operational aspects. A questionnaire was administered online to internal stakeholders to collect their opinions on these material topics. Based on opinions received, the 26 identified issues were prioritised into four levels. The most pertinent topics (Level I) of the Group included anti-corruption, precautionary measures of child/forced labour, operating compliance and protection of intellectual property rights. The final results were reviewed and validated by the management of the Group.

results.text: Effective management of environmental, social and ethical risks the freight forwarding business faces is a prime concern of the Group and to address this issue, we use internal controls and risk management systems. The Group incorporates material ESG topics in its management system to ensure effective risk management.
results.retrieval_text:

BOARD STATEMENT

[Content]
Effective management of environmental, social and ethical risks the freight forwarding business faces is a prime concern of the Group and to address this issue, we use internal controls and risk management systems. The Board of Directors is responsible for identifying ESG risks including climate-related risks, whereas the management is responsible for evaluating the effectiveness of the internal control and risk management system and reports to the Board and the Audit Committee on a yearly basis. The Group incorporates material ESG topics in its management system to ensure effective risk management.

results.text: The Group ensures adherence to labour standards and prohibits all forms of unethical practices, which also applies to its suppliers and subcontractors. We take rigorous measures to prohibit child labour or forced labour. In order to prevent hiring child labour or forced labour, the Human Resource Department conducts a background check of all job applicants under the Background Check Policy to verify their identities and age during the recruitment process. We strictly comply with relevant labour laws and regulations in places of operations. In case of any instance of child employment, we would immediately terminate the contract.
results.retrieval_text:
[Section]
OUR PEOPLE / Employee Profile

[Content]
The Group ensures adherence to labour standards and prohibits all forms of unethical practices, which also applies to its suppliers and subcontractors. We take rigorous measures to prohibit child labour or forced labour. In order to prevent hiring child labour or forced labour, the Human Resource Department conducts a background check of all job applicants under the Background Check Policy to verify their identities and age during the recruitment process. We strictly comply with relevant labour laws and regulations in places of operations. In case of any instance of child employment, we would immediately terminate the contract.

[Section]
BOARD STATEMENT

[Content]
Management of risks and opportunities associated with sustainability has become board level matter and therefore we have set up an ESG Committee comprising of senior management to formulate ESG-related strategies, policies and targets. Our Environmental and Social Responsibility Policy delegates ESG related responsibilities and specifies objectives to all parties associated with the Group including its subsidiaries, associated companies and affiliates.
